messages:
sara: Quick ask — can someone run a focused perf+quality pass on model-x using a hybrid int4+FP8 config? We started seeing a ~6% p50 hit on long prompts in prod-like traces. Need numbers for a canary decision.

mike: Can you paste a repro command and the specific promptset? Also which commit/PR this was observed on?

sara: Repro and PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4823
Sample bench command we used:
```
./tools/run_inference_bench --model=model-x --quant=hybrid_layerA_int4_fp8.json --seq_len=2048 --warm_kv=true --batch=1 --iters=1000
```
Promptset: eval/promptsets/longform/2026-03-hallucination-checks.json

chen: Thanks. Two quick clarifications:
1) Was KV cache warm during the runs? (warm_kv=true above, good)
2) Can you also capture the token length histogram and the p99 tail? Long prompts can shift kernel selection.

alex-bot: Job scheduled: bench-runner #78291 (started). Link: https://ci.internal/jobs/78291. Notifying eng-runtime.

mike: For comparison, please run these configs in parallel:
- hybrid_layerA_int4_fp8.json (what you ran)
- full_int8_quant.json
Also capture the eval loss & QA-accuracy on the attached promptset. If regression >5% on p50 or quality drop >1.5% we should fallback to full_int8 for the canary.

priya: Ping on kernel version — do we want to pin the runtime kernels to v2.3.1 for parity with previous runs? CI default jumped to v2.4 last week.

sara: Good catch. Started with kernel v2.4 which might explain perf delta. I'll re-run pinned to v2.3.1 and re-run both configs.

chen: I'll take profiling — will attach a sampling flame + nvprof capture. Can you leave the job window open for ~45m? I want the heavy tail cases.

mike: Also include a small sample of model outputs for the top-100 examples from the promptset so we can run automated QA diffs (EM and BLEU where applicable).

sara: Will do. Re-run queued with v2.3.1 and both quant configs. ETA ~2.5h. Leaving the original run logs in the PR for reference.

priya: If you want, I can kick off an A/B canary in staging as soon as we have numbers. I can also add an automatic rollback policy if quality delta exceeds threshold.

sara: Awesome — thanks everyone. Will post results + links when runs complete. :thumbsup:

mike: Acked. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

alex-bot: bench-runner #78291 completed: exit=0. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/78291. (profiling still pending per chen)

chen: Profiling captured; uploading flamegraphs now. I'll comment on the PR with hotspots and a recommendation (likely kernel tweak + small layer reassign).

sara: Perfect — I'll wait for your call before opening the staging canary.
